name: proyecto-usuarios
description: Sistema de usuarios: backend (Express + MySQL) y dos frontends (React Router y useState)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend-router install && npm --prefix frontend-usestate install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,router,usestate -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend-router run dev" "npm --prefix frontend-usestate run dev"
